lines.text: Woe comes to the land of whirring wings along the rivers of Cush, which sends couriers by sea in papyrus vessels.
Swift messengers are sent to a tall, smooth-skinned, widely feared nation whose land is divided by mountains.
When a banner is raised and a ram's horn sounds, the world will see and hear, while the LORD quietly looks on from His dwelling place.
Before the harvest, He will cut off the shoots with a pruning knife and leave the branches to birds of prey and wild animals.
At that time, the tall, widely feared nation will bring gifts to the LORD of Hosts at Mount Sinai.
